title: Anatoly and Cockroaches
statementMd:
Anatoly lives in the university dorm as many other students do. As you know, cockroaches are also living there together with students. Cockroaches might be of two colors: black and red. There are $*n*$ cockroaches living in Anatoly's room.

Anatoly just made all his cockroaches to form a single line. As he is a perfectionist, he would like the colors of cockroaches in the line to **alternate**. He has a can of black paint and a can of red paint. In one turn he can either swap any two cockroaches, or take any single cockroach and change it's color.

Help Anatoly find out the minimum number of turns he needs to make the colors of cockroaches in the line alternate.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of cockroaches.

The second line contains a string of length $*n*$, consisting of characters '`b`' and '`r`' that denote black cockroach and red cockroach respectively.

## Output

Print one integer — the minimum number of moves Anatoly has to perform in order to make the colors of cockroaches in the line to alternate.

## Note

In the first sample, Anatoly has to swap third and fourth cockroaches. He needs $1$ turn to do this.

In the second sample, the optimum answer is to paint the second and the fourth cockroaches red. This requires $2$ turns.

In the third sample, the colors of cockroaches in the line are alternating already, thus the answer is $0$.
statementZhMd:
阿纳托利和许多其他学生一样，住在大学宿舍里。众所周知，蟑螂也和学生们一起生活在那里。蟑螂可能有两种颜色：黑色和红色。阿纳托利的房间里住着 $*n*$ 只蟑螂。

阿纳托利刚刚让所有蟑螂排成了一条直线。由于他是一个完美主义者，他希望直线上蟑螂的颜色能够**交替**出现。他有一罐黑色颜料和一罐红色颜料。每次操作中，他可以交换任意两只蟑螂，或者选取任意一只蟑螂并改变它的颜色。

请帮助阿纳托利求出使直线上蟑螂的颜色交替出现所需的最少操作次数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——蟑螂的数量。

第二行包含一个长度为 $*n*$ 的字符串，仅由字符 '`b`' 和 '`r`' 组成，分别表示黑色蟑螂和红色蟑螂。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——为了使直线上蟑螂的颜色交替出现，阿纳托利需要进行的最少操作次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，阿纳托利需要交换第三只和第四只蟑螂。他需要进行 $1$ 次操作。

在第二个样例中，最优方案是将第二只和第四只蟑螂涂成红色。这需要进行 $2$ 次操作。

在第三个样例中，直线上蟑螂的颜色已经交替出现，因此答案为 $0$。
